style: 既存の彩色会話人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画。囚人と職人の役だけが本文の設定。具体的な年齢感・外見・服装は今回の美術設定で、固有名・他の依頼人との同一性は付与しない。牢・格子・聖像・石・宝玉は画へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG. One centered adult person in a waist-up composition, complete head silhouette and both hands fully visible, lower edge below the waist, generous transparent margins beside the shoulders and above the head. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and wool, readable facial features, muted earthy colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. Deliver a PNG with genuine transparent alpha throughout the surrounding area. Clothing surfaces are plain and unlettered. Subject: an unnamed adult prisoner in the underground cell beneath a chapel statue. A slight build, warm olive skin, short uneven dark brown hair with a few gray strands, dark watchful eyes, simple worn charcoal-gray linen tunic with a loose brown wool shoulder cloth. The person turns slightly away and raises one empty hand loosely in front of the mouth and lower cheek in a wary protective gesture; both eyes remain clearly readable. The other empty hand rests near the waist. Show an intact, uninjured person, a quiet guarded expression, ordinary cloth sleeves and an open neckline. The isolated body silhouette is the entire visible subject.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。成人1人を中央に置き、頭部の輪郭と両手全体が入り、腰より下で終わる構図。肩の左右と頭上に十分な透過余白。1024×1536の縦画面。麻・ウールの質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。読み取りやすい顔、落ち着いた土色、左上から柔らかな暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。周囲の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。衣服は無地。人物は礼拝堂の聖像の下にある地下牢の匿名の成人。細身の体格、温かなオリーブ色の肌、灰色の毛が少し混じる短く不揃いな濃茶の髪、警戒する濃い色の目。使い込まれた炭色の麻の上着に、茶色のウールの肩掛けをゆるく重ねる。少し身をそらし、空の片手を口元と頬の下へゆるく上げて顔を守る。両目は明瞭に見える。もう一方の空の手は腰付近に置く。傷のない姿、静かに警戒する表情、普通の布の袖と開いた襟元。見せる対象は人物の輪郭内だけ。
